title: Achievement Drought Tracker
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player and achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steam:player
| stats max(_time) as last_session, max(achievement_time) as last_achievement by game_name
| eval days_since_achievement=round((last_session-last_achievement)/86400,1)
| where days_since_achievement>30
| sort - days_since_achievement
description: Lists games you still play but have not progressed in for a long time, a fun way to separate comfort games from stalled campaign commitments.
value: Backlog pressure usually comes from games stuck in limbo; this query surfaces the titles still taking time without offering new progress.
implementation: Forward Steam session and achievement timestamps; review games with long achievement droughts when deciding what to finish or shelve.
visualization: Table of active games by days since the last unlocked achievement.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which games you still play even though you have not really made progress in them for ages.
